posts.cooked:
My specific doubt is on the topic: End-term exam marks

My doubt is:

I appeared for the End-term exam in Programming in Python (31st August). My grade currently shows as U. which was unexpected since my performance in assignment and quizzes throughout the course was comparatively better.

I kindly request a clarification of the evaluation process and, if possible, a re - evaluation of my marks. I would be grateful for your guidance regarding this matter.

Thank you.

posts.name: Anand Kumar Upadhyay
posts.cooked: I understand that OPPE is mandatory as per IITM rules. However, not attending OPPE should not mean failing the entire course if my overall score is above the passing marks. If I have scored enough to pass, then my grade should reflect that. I agree to take OPPE in the next term as per the rules, but I kindly request you to recheck my score and, if it is above the passing threshold, update my grade accordingly.

posts.name: Sarthak Jalota
posts.cooked:
Please attach your dashboard results for better assistance. You must score more than 40 in one of the OPPEs to be eligible for the grade else it is I_OP (It is clearly mentioned in the grading document).

If your total course score is less than 35 (Not ET score* but total score), in that case you need to redo the course and grade is U.

posts.name: Anand Kumar Upadhyay
posts.cooked:
I have scored more than 35 as my total course score in Python.

However, since I did not attend OPPE, my grade should be I_OP as per the grading policy, but my dashboard is currently showing U.

I am attaching my score screenshot for your reference.

Kindly review my marks and update my grade to I_OP so that I can appear for OPPE in the next term.

Also, I would be going to study in the Diploma level from the next term, so please help me resolve this issue.

posts.name: Sarthak Jalota
posts.cooked:
Formula: T = 0.1 GAA1 (objective) + 0.1GAA2 (programming) + 0.1Qz1+ 0.4F+ 0.25 max(PE1, PE2) + 0.15 min(PE1, PE2) — capped to 100

T = 3.2 + 3.2 + 2.5 + 18 → 26.9 (rounded up to 27)

GAA1 → 0.1 x 32 = 3.2
GAA2 → 0.1 x 32 = 3.2
Q1 → 0.1 x 25 = 2.5
ET → 0.4 x 45 = 18

T < 40. You have failed the course so U grade.

posts.cooked: “I have just failed in Python and received a U grade, which is correct. My question is: can I appear for improvement in Python and at the same time start the Diploma level, since I have already completed 7 Foundation courses?”

posts.name: Ashutosh Kumar Mishra
posts.cooked:
No you must pass the all foundation level courses and then you will be eligible for

diploma level .
